Cerebellar neuroscience

Staf Bauer

Interested in how the cerebellum shapes rhythmic movements, using electrophysiological recordings, combined with videography, and optogenetics.

  • Now PhD candidate, Department of Neuroscience, Erasmus MC, Rotterdam (thesis submitted November 2026)
